messages:
Maya: Proposal: staggered regional canary for model v4 with quantized fallback chain. Purpose: validate latency & token economics per-region before wide launch. Need agreement on slices + enterprise holdout handling.

Chris: High level OK. Specific asks: how do Dedicated orgs opt-out? any SLA changes during canary? :question: 

Maya: Plan sketch: 
- Shadowing: 12h global shadow to collect perf + failure modes
- Canary1: 0.5% tenants in ap-south for 3h (zonal, low-traffic)
- Canary2: 2% tenants in eu-west + ap-south for 6h
- Canary3: 10% spread across US/EU for 12h with A/B control group
- Ramp: gradual 10% increments every 2h after canary windows if metrics OK
Dedicated orgs: default OFF. Add org-level flag override for on-prem/dedicated customers.

Leo: Telemetry we need: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, tokens/resp, model-switch-count, fallback-count, and hallucination alerts (top-3 hallucination heuristics). For A/B: run `ab-runner --control v3 --variant v4 --min-samples 3000 --metrics latency,cost,hallucination_rate`.

SRE-Jordan: Rollback triggers (auto + manual):
- auto fail if p99 gen latency > 200ms for 5m
- auto fail if 5xx ratio > 0.75% for 5m
- auto fail if token-cost per request increases > 25% for 10m
- manual rollback for any sustained semantic regression flagged by QA/quality-alerts
Circuit breakers: per-node queue > 150 for 3m OR GPU memory > 90% for 2m -> throttle slice and failover.

Maya: Fallback chain: v4 (fp16) -> v4-quant (int8) -> v3 (stable). Sticky fallback timer 180s. If same tenant experiences >2 fallbacks in 20m, mark tenant as blocked for v4 for 24h and page oncall.

Chris: For enterprise legal/residency: if tenant has data_residency constraint we must not route to regions outside allowed list. Flag schema needs `region_constraint` and `requires_kms`. Also add `org_override: true` for dedicated customers.

Maya: Example flag payload we expect ops to implement:
```json
{
  "flag": "model_v4_canary",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "tenants": ["acme-inc","beta-co"],
  "pct": 0.5,
  "regions": ["ap-south"],
  "org_override": true,
  "region_constraint": null,
  "requires_kms": false
}
```

Leo: Priming job idea for cache/kv warm: `./infra/prime_model.sh --tenant acme-inc --model v4 --requests 500 --seed-prompts ./examples/seed.json` (log to rollout ledger). Also run synthetic latency probes from each region 5m before slice start.

deploy-bot: release: feature-flag-controller v3.1 deployed to staging at 2026-05-05T11:02Z :white_check_mark:

SRE-Jordan: Dashboards: create a per-region matrix: p95 vs token-cost delta vs fallback-count. Add alert policy: if any region shows correlated spike (latency + cost + fallback) escalate to P1.

Maya: A/B guardrails: require min-sample 3000 and >95% data completeness for metric collection before deciding lift. Use overlapping rolling windows (start new slice every 50% of window) to smooth cold starts.

Chris: Operational notes:
- Ensure runbook lists how to toggle org_override and how to forcibly block tenants.
- Dedicated customers must get an email + postmortem if affected; require account-ops approval for any org_override change.

Leo: I'll add ab-run configs and dashboard queries to the PR. Will include synthetic probe outputs.

Maya: Owners: product=Maya, eng-platform=Leo, ops=Chris, oncall=SRE-Jordan. Actions: Leo -> PR with telemetry + priming scripts, Chris -> flag API & org_override flow, Jordan -> alerts + runbook. Shiproom invite after PRs linked.

SRE-Jordan: One more: add a rapid-escalation throttle: >4 rollbacks across any region in 30m -> global halt and sticky fallback to v3 for 1h.

Maya: Thanks all. If no objections I'll create the shiproom invite and draft the canary playbook doc. :calendar:
